\noindent{\large\textbf{S2 Table. All contrasts of the comparison on trader outcomes, both windows and both analyses.}}

\smallskip
\noindent Kendall $\tau_b$ of score $a$ and score $b$ with each later outcome of the GMX~V2 contract traders with at least three closes in the label window, their difference $\Delta\tau=\tau(a)-\tau(b)$, and percentile intervals from one paired contract bootstrap per label (2,000 resamples, seed 42; the same resample indices for every score). The pairs, the six labels, the decision contrasts P and Q with Bonferroni 97.5\% intervals on the liquidation-free close rate and the stratified rows were registered for the window W1 (commit \texttt{0d3a057}) before this study extracted its logs. In the registered analysis the rows of the registered pairs are the registered evaluation; the rules R1--R3 are decided by P and Q on the liquidation-free close rate (with the stratified P) and by P on the profitable and non-loss shares in W1, and rows marked $^{*}$ were not named in the registration. In the revised analysis, whose amounts, tokens and score windows (the twelve months before each freeze) were defined after every registered result was known, all rows are a re-analysis. Only P and Q in W1 carry Bonferroni-adjusted 97.5\% intervals; all other intervals are unadjusted, and those that enter no rule are descriptive. Stratified rows average $\tau_b$ within strata of 3--4, 5--9, 10--24 and 25 or more label-window closes, weighted by the number of contract pairs; the summaries do not record how many resamples gave a stratified value. $^{\dagger}$Label grows with the number of closes. $^{\ddagger}$Amount-weighted allowance and transfer layers walked alone with uniform restarts, the end points of the mixed walk of a companion study by the same authors. $^{*}$Not named in the registration document; computed by the evaluation code committed with it. Contracts absent from a graph score zero under that graph's scores.
